items.title: Google, ChatGPT & Others With Coupon Codes Directly In The AI Answers
items.excerpt: Ahead of the holidays, Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT and other AI engines now surface merchant coupon and promo codes directly in answers, bypassing coupon sites.
items.rationale: AI answers now hand shoppers promo codes directly, cutting coupon affiliates out of the path to purchase; merchants need to rethink how and where they publish holiday promotions.

items.title: Bing & Microsoft Ads With Made With AI Label
items.excerpt: Microsoft is now showing a "Made with AI" label in the corner of AI-generated images on some ads across Microsoft Advertising and Bing Search.
items.rationale: A new visible disclosure label on AI-generated ad images across Microsoft Advertising, which changes how AI creative is presented to searchers.

items.title: Model sues RomperJack after 2021 photos became AI-generated Instagram ads
items.excerpt: Paid in clothes with no signed release, model Jeffrey Stanfield says RomperJack's new owner turned his 2021 shoot into AI-generated video ads on Instagram — testing whether old photo licenses cover synthetic performances.
items.rationale: A fresh lawsuit testing whether old photo-shoot rights cover AI-generated video ads; a direct risk for brands that animate archive talent imagery.

items.title: Loblaw lets Meta's Muse plan meals and check out groceries in Canada
items.excerpt: Loblaw becomes the first Canadian retail connector for Meta's Muse AI agent, which plans meals and checks out grocery baskets; Google adds Loblaw audiences to DV360 the same day.
items.rationale: A new retail connector for Meta's shopping agent, plus Loblaw retail-media audiences arriving in DV360, show agentic commerce and retail media moving together.

items.title: 카페24 "AI 경유 쇼핑 주문, 1년 새 4배 증가…자사몰 AI 접근성 높여야"
items.excerpt: 카페24 자사몰 데이터 분석 결과 올해 3분기 주요 AI 서비스를 거쳐 유입된 방문은 전년 대비 2배 이상, 주문은 약 4배 늘었다. AI 유입 고객의 상세페이지 직행 비중은 포털 검색 대비 약 2배, 전환율은 약 2.5배 높았다.
items.rationale: First-party Cafe24 data shows AI-referred orders up about 4x year over year, with roughly 2.5x higher conversion than portal search. That gives D2C sellers hard numbers for prioritizing AI-channel readiness.
